SELECT MAX(frpm.ages_5_17_free_meal_eligibility_rate) AS max_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.school_id = satscores.school_id
JOIN frpm ON schools.school_id = frpm.school_id
GROUP BY schools.school_id
HAVING AVG(satscores.sat_total >= 1500) > 0.3

SELECT 
    schools.school_name,
    schools.county,
    schools.grade_span,
    frpm.percent_eligible_frpm_5_17
FROM 
    schools
JOIN 
    frpm
    ON schools.school_code = frpm.school_code
WHERE 
    schools.county = 'Los Angeles'
    AND schools.grade_span = 'K-9'

SELECT 
  schools.district_code,
  (frpm.k12_free_meals / CAST(frpm.k12_enrollment AS FLOAT)) * 100 AS percent_eligible_free_k12
FROM 
  schools
JOIN 
  frpm ON schools.school_code = frpm.school_code
WHERE 
  schools.admin_first_name = 'Alusine'

SELECT "BIRD evidence" AS nces_school_id, "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment
FROM schools
WHERE "CDS" IN ('1751010130583','1612910137588','1611760134270')
  AND "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" = (
    SELECT MAX("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM schools
    WHERE "CDS" IN ('1751010130583','1612910137588','1611760134270')
  )

WITH hth_san_diego_schools AS (
  SELECT school_id
  FROM schools
  WHERE charter_number = 756
    AND LOWER(mailing_city) = 'san diego'
),
school_sat_counts AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, COALESCE(SUM(sa.num_test_takers), 0) AS total_test_takers
  FROM hth_san_diego_schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON s.school_id = sa.school_id
  GROUP BY s.school_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_test_takers), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers_per_school
FROM school_sat_counts;

WITH district_high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.name,
    s.nces_district_id,
    s.currently_operating,
    s.grades_offered,
    s.lowest_grade_offered,
    s.highest_grade_offered,
    s.lowest_grade_enrolled,
    s.highest_grade_enrolled,
    s.grade_span_served
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.nces_district_id = '0613360'
    AND s.currently_operating = 1
    AND s.highest_grade_enrolled = 12 -- Actually enrolls students through grade 12
),
satless_high_schools AS (
  SELECT
    d.school_id,
    d.name,
    d.grade_span_served,
    d.lowest_grade_enrolled
  FROM district_high_schools d
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT school_id, SUM(num_test_takers) AS total_sat_takers
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY school_id
  ) sat ON d.school_id = sat.school_id
  WHERE COALESCE(sat.total_sat_takers, 0) = 0
),
min_grade_order AS (
  SELECT
    lowest_grade_enrolled,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(lowest_grade_enrolled) IN ('ps', 'pre-k', 'prekindergarten', 'preschool') THEN 0
      WHEN LOWER(lowest_grade_enrolled) IN ('kg', 'k', 'kindergarten') THEN 1
      WHEN CAST(lowest_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 12 THEN CAST(lowest_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER) + 1
      ELSE 100
    END AS grade_order
  FROM satless_high_schools
),
earliest_grade AS (
  SELECT MIN(grade_order) AS earliest_grade_order
  FROM min_grade_order
)
SELECT
  s.name,
  s.grade_span_served,
  s.lowest_grade_enrolled
FROM satless_high_schools s
JOIN (
  SELECT lowest_grade_enrolled,
         CASE
           WHEN LOWER(lowest_grade_enrolled) IN ('ps', 'pre-k', 'prekindergarten', 'preschool') THEN 0
           WHEN LOWER(lowest_grade_enrolled) IN ('kg', 'k', 'kindergarten') THEN 1
           WHEN CAST(lowest_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 12 THEN CAST(lowest_grade_enrolled AS INTEGER) + 1
           ELSE 100
         END AS grade_order
  FROM satless_high_schools
) o ON s.lowest_grade_enrolled = o.lowest_grade_enrolled
JOIN earliest_grade e ON o.grade_order = e.earliest_grade_order
ORDER BY s.name;

SELECT
  s.name AS school_name,
  s.mailing_street AS full_mailing_street_address,
  sat.reading_avg
FROM
  schools s
JOIN
  satscores sat ON s.school_id = sat.school_id
WHERE
  s.agency = 'State Board of Education'
  AND sat.scope = 'school'
  AND sat.reading_avg = (
    SELECT MAX(sat2.reading_avg)
    FROM satscores sat2
    JOIN schools s2 ON s2.school_id = sat2.school_id
    WHERE s2.agency = 'State Board of Education'
      AND sat2.scope = 'school'
  )
;

SELECT city
FROM schools
WHERE county = 'Alameda'
  AND educational_instruction_level_code = 'HS'
  AND breakfast_provision_status = 'Provision 2'
  AND lowest_grade = 9
  AND highest_grade = 12
  AND cds_code = '1611920113902'
LIMIT 1;

WITH sbc_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.school_id,
    s.name AS school_name,
    s.phone
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.authorization_type = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
),
high_scorers AS (
  SELECT
    f.school_id,
    COUNT(*) AS high_score_count
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN satscores sat ON f.school_id = sat.school_id
  WHERE sat.total_score >= 1500
  GROUP BY f.school_id
),
sbc_school_scores AS (
  SELECT
    sbc_schools.school_name,
    sbc_schools.phone,
    COALESCE(high_scorers.high_score_count, 0) AS high_score_count
  FROM sbc_schools
  LEFT JOIN high_scorers
    ON sbc_schools.school_id = high_scorers.school_id
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  phone
FROM sbc_school_scores
WHERE high_score_count = (
  SELECT MAX(high_score_count) FROM sbc_school_scores
)
AND high_score_count > 0
ORDER BY school_name;

WITH target_school AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM schools
  WHERE "CDSCode" = '1611190130609' AND "DirectFundedCharterSchool" = 'Yes'
)
SELECT
  ts."SchoolName",
  s."NumTstTakers" AS num_sat_test_takers,
  s."AveMathScore" AS avg_sat_math_score
FROM target_school ts
JOIN satscores s
  ON ts."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"

WITH target_school AS (
    SELECT SatNumTstTkn
    FROM satscores
    WHERE CDS = '7618040730051'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools_ahead
FROM satscores, target_school
WHERE County = 'Contra Costa'
  AND SatNumTstTkn > target_school.SatNumTstTkn

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.ncessch = sat.ncessch
WHERE s.mailingcity = 'San Francisco'
  AND sat.sat_read_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.sat_math_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.sat_write_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND (sat.sat_read_avg + sat.sat_math_avg + sat.sat_write_avg) >= 1500
  AND s.district_type IN (
    'Unified School District',
    'High School District',
    'Elementary School District',
    'County Office of Education (COE)'
  );

WITH youth_authority_schools AS (
  SELECT school_id
  FROM schools
  WHERE school_type = 'Youth Authority Facility'
),
meal_counts AS (
  SELECT
    f.school_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.frpm_eligible_5_17), 0) AS eligible
  FROM youth_authority_schools s
  LEFT JOIN frpm f
    ON f.school_id = s.school_id AND f.year = '2014-2015'
  GROUP BY s.school_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(eligible), 2) AS avg_eligible_per_school
FROM meal_counts;

SELECT name AS school_name, education_instruction_level_name
FROM schools
WHERE cds = '1612590136051'
LIMIT 1;

WITH bird_evidence_schools AS (
  SELECT school_id, name AS school_name, administrator_email
  FROM schools
  WHERE district_ownership_type = 'State Board of Education'
),
high_scorers AS (
  SELECT school_id, COUNT(*) AS num_1500plus
  FROM satscores
  WHERE total_score >= 1500
  GROUP BY school_id
),
max_scorers AS (
  SELECT MAX(num_1500plus) AS max_1500plus
  FROM high_scorers
)
SELECT
  b.school_name,
  b.administrator_email
FROM bird_evidence_schools b
JOIN high_scorers h ON b.school_id = h.school_id
JOIN max_scorers m ON h.num_1500plus = m.max_1500plus
ORDER BY b.school_name;

WITH middle_schools AS (
  SELECT
    School,
    "School Type" AS school_type,
    Latitude
  FROM schools
  WHERE
    -- School type denotes middle school, junior high, or intermediate (typical middle-level names)
    LOWER("School Type") LIKE '%middle%'
    OR LOWER("School Type") LIKE '%junior high%'
    OR LOWER("School Type") LIKE '%intermediate%'
    -- School name marks a middle-school-level school, e.g., "______ Middle School"
    OR LOWER(School) LIKE '% middle %'
    OR LOWER(School) LIKE 'middle %'
    OR LOWER(School) LIKE '% middle'
    OR LOWER(School) LIKE '%middle%'
    OR LOWER(School) LIKE '%intermediate%'
    OR LOWER(School) LIKE '%junior high%'
)
SELECT
  School AS "School Name",
  school_type AS "School Type",
  Latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM middle_schools)
ORDER BY School;

WITH la_county_schools_2007 AS (
    SELECT s.school_id
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.county_name = 'Los Angeles'
      AND s.opened_year = 2007
      AND s.district_type IN ('School District', 'County Office of Education')
),
sat_participation AS (
    SELECT sc.school_id, COALESCE(sf.num_test_takers, 0) AS sat_test_takers
    FROM la_county_schools_2007 sc
    LEFT JOIN satscores sf ON sf.school_id = sc.school_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(sat_test_takers), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers_per_school
FROM sat_participation
;

WITH active_charters AS (
    SELECT
        s.school_id,
        s.funding_category,
        s.status,
        s.k12_2014_15_enrollment,
        s.free_reduced_price_meal_eligible_pct
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.charter = 1
      AND s.status = 'Open'
      AND s.funding_category IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
sat_by_school AS (
    SELECT
        f.school_id,
        COALESCE(sa.avg_reading_score,0) + COALESCE(sa.avg_math_score,0) + COALESCE(sa.avg_writing_score,0) AS combined_sat
    FROM frpm f
    LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON f.school_id = sa.school_id
)
SELECT
    a.funding_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.school_id) AS num_active_charter_schools,
    SUM(a.k12_2014_15_enrollment) AS total_2014_15_k12_enrollment,
    ROUND(AVG(a.free_reduced_price_meal_eligible_pct), 2) AS avg_meal_eligibility_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(
        CASE WHEN sat.combined_sat > 0 THEN sat.combined_sat ELSE NULL END
    ), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM active_charters a
LEFT JOIN sat_by_school sat ON a.school_id = sat.school_id
GROUP BY a.funding_category
ORDER BY a.funding_category

WITH state_special_schools AS (
  SELECT
    sch.school_code,
    sch.name,
    sch.k12enrt AS k12_enrollment,
    sch.k12grage AS k12_grade_age
  FROM schools sch
  WHERE sch.county = 'State Special Schools'
    AND sch.ay == '2014-2015'
),
-- Map the grade-level codes to an integer for ordering: P=0, K=1, 1=2, ..., 12=13
earliest_grade_per_school AS (
  SELECT
    sss.school_code,
    sss.name,
    sss.k12_enrollment,
    MIN(CASE
        WHEN TRIM(grade) = 'P' THEN 0
        WHEN TRIM(grade) = 'K' THEN 1
        ELSE CAST(grade AS INTEGER) + 1
      END) AS earliest_grade_num,
    MIN(grade) AS earliest_grade_code
  FROM state_special_schools sss,
       json_each(sss.k12_grade_age) -- Unnest the grade-level array
  GROUP BY sss.school_code, sss.name, sss.k12_enrollment
),
sat_participation AS (
  SELECT
    sat.school_code,
    SUM(sat.tst_takers) AS sat_test_takers
  FROM satscores sat
  WHERE sat.ay = '2014-2015'
  GROUP BY sat.school_code
)
SELECT
  egps.name AS school_name,
  egps.earliest_grade_code AS earliest_grade_covered,
  egps.k12_enrollment,
  COALESCE(sp.sat_test_takers, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM earliest_grade_per_school egps
LEFT JOIN sat_participation sp ON egps.school_code = sp.school_code
ORDER BY
  egps.earliest_grade_num DESC,        -- Latest starting grade first
  egps.k12_enrollment DESC,            -- If tied, largest enrollment
  egps.name ASC                        -- If still tied, alphabetically
LIMIT 1;

WITH county_charter_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.cdscode,
    s.funding_type,
    s.status,
    s.school_type
  FROM schools s
  WHERE
    s.school_type = 'Charter'
    AND s.operated_by = 'County Office of Education'
    AND s.funding_type IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
    AND s.status = 'Active'
),
frpm_summary AS (
  SELECT
    f.cdscode,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.grade_group = 'K-12' THEN f.enrolled ELSE 0 END) AS k12_enrolled,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.grade_group = 'K-12' THEN f.frpm_eligible ELSE 0 END) AS k12_frpm_eligible
  FROM frpm f
  GROUP BY f.cdscode
)
SELECT
  ccs.funding_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.cdscode) AS num_schools,
  SUM(COALESCE(fs.k12_enrolled, 0)) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  SUM(COALESCE(fs.k12_frpm_eligible, 0)) AS total_k12_frpm_eligible
FROM county_charter_schools ccs
LEFT JOIN frpm_summary fs ON ccs.cdscode = fs.cdscode
GROUP BY ccs.funding_type
ORDER BY CASE ccs.funding_type
  WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
  ELSE 3 END

WITH closed_schools_with_scores AS (
  SELECT
    s.name,
    s.district,
    s.county,
    st.sat_writing_avg
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores st ON s.school_id = st.school_id
  WHERE s.status = 'Closed' AND st.sat_writing_avg IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_scores AS (
  SELECT
    sat_writing_avg,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat_writing_avg DESC) AS score_rank
  FROM closed_schools_with_scores
)
SELECT
  cs.name,
  cs.district,
  cs.county,
  cs.sat_writing_avg
FROM closed_schools_with_scores cs
JOIN ranked_scores rs ON cs.sat_writing_avg = rs.sat_writing_avg
WHERE rs.score_rank = 2
ORDER BY cs.name;

WITH open_high_schools AS (
  SELECT school_id
  FROM schools
  WHERE status = 'Active'
    AND instr_level = 'High School'
    AND state = 'CA'
    AND type = 'Public'
),
schools_with_sat AS (
  SELECT school_id, SUM(num_test_takers) AS total_test_takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY school_id
)
SELECT COUNT(ohs.school_id) AS num_schools_with_zero_sat
FROM open_high_schools ohs
LEFT JOIN schools_with_sat sws ON ohs.school_id = sws.school_id
WHERE sws.total_test_takers IS NULL OR sws.total_test_takers = 0;

WITH fremont_info AS (
  SELECT county_code, county_name
  FROM schools
  WHERE cds_code = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
county_schools AS (
  SELECT
    f.county_code,
    f.county_name,
    s.cds_code
  FROM schools s
  JOIN fremont_info f
    ON s.county_code = f.county_code
  WHERE s.school_type = 'K-12'
),
filtered_frpm AS (
  SELECT
    cs.county_name,
    cs.cds_code,
    frpm.frpm_count_k12,
    frpm.free_meal_count_k12,
    frpm.enrollment_k12,
    frpm.charter_indicator,
    ROUND(100.0 * frpm.free_meal_count_k12 / NULLIF(frpm.enrollment_k12, 0), 2) AS free_meal_percent,
    ROUND(100.0 * frpm.frpm_count_k12 / NULLIF(frpm.enrollment_k12, 0), 2) AS frpm_percent
  FROM county_schools cs
  JOIN frpm ON cs.cds_code = frpm.cds_code
  WHERE frpm.free_meal_count_k12 > 500
    AND frpm.frpm_count_k12 < 700
),
sat_totals AS (
  SELECT
    s.cds_code,
    COALESCE(s.reading_avg, 0) + COALESCE(s.math_avg, 0) + COALESCE(s.writing_avg, 0) AS sat_total
  FROM satscores s
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    st.sat_total
  FROM filtered_frpm f
  LEFT JOIN sat_totals st ON f.cds_code = st.cds_code
)
SELECT
  MAX(county_name) AS county_name,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(free_meal_percent), 2) AS avg_free_meal_percent,
  ROUND(AVG(frpm_percent), 2) AS avg_frpm_percent,
  SUM(CASE WHEN charter_indicator = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter_schools,
  SUM(CASE WHEN charter_indicator = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sat_total IS NOT NULL THEN sat_total END), 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM joined;

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / 12 AS avg_schools_opened_per_month_1980
FROM schools
WHERE 
    county = 'San Diego' 
    AND opened_year = 1980
    AND district_id IS NOT NULL

WITH ca_high_math AS (
  SELECT s.ncessch
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores t ON s.ncessch = t.ncessch
  WHERE s.state = 'CA'
    AND t.satmath >= 400
),
virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT ncessch
  FROM schools
  WHERE virtual IN ('F', 'P')
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ca_high_math.ncessch) FILTER (WHERE ca_high_math.ncessch IN (SELECT ncessch FROM virtual_schools))
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ca_high_math.ncessch),0)
  , 1
  ) AS percentage_virtual
FROM ca_high_math;

WITH school_info AS (
    SELECT
        s."School Name" AS school_name,
        s."County" AS county,
        s."District" AS district,
        s."City" AS city,
        f."K-12 Enrollment" AS k12_enrollment,
        f."K-12 FRPM Eligible" AS frpm_eligible,
        f."K-12 FRPM %" AS frpm_percent,
        s."CDS Code" AS cds_code
    FROM schools s
    LEFT JOIN frpm f
        ON s."CDS Code" = f."CDS Code"
    WHERE s."CDS Code" = '1612590137943'
),
sat_info AS (
    SELECT
        sa."CDS Code" AS cds_code,
        sa."Number of Test Takers" AS num_test_takers,
        sa."Average Reading Score" AS avg_reading,
        sa."Average Math Score" AS avg_math,
        sa."Average Writing Score" AS avg_writing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sa."Total Score" >= 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_1500plus
    FROM satscores sa
    WHERE sa."CDS Code" = '1612590137943'
    GROUP BY sa."CDS Code", sa."Number of Test Takers", sa."Average Reading Score", sa."Average Math Score", sa."Average Writing Score"
)
SELECT
    si.school_name,
    si.county,
    si.district,
    si.city,
    si.k12_enrollment,
    si.frpm_eligible,
    si.frpm_percent,
    sat.num_test_takers,
    sat.avg_reading,
    sat.avg_math,
    sat.avg_writing,
    sat.num_1500plus
FROM school_info si
LEFT JOIN sat_info sat
    ON si.cds_code = sat.cds_code;

WITH eligible_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.schnam AS school_name,
    s.GSserved AS grades_served,
    s.Charter AS charter_status,
    fr.K12Free AS free_meal_count,
    fr.K12Enroll AS enrollment,
    sat.readnum AS sat_read,
    sat.mathnum AS sat_math,
    sat.writnum AS sat_writing,
    s.Cdscode
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN frpm fr ON s.Cdscode = fr.Cdscode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.Cdscode = sat.Cdscode
  WHERE s.countyname = 'Alameda'
    AND (
      -- Serves 12th grade: GSserved includes '12'
      instr(s.GSserved, '12') > 0
    )
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    -- Must have at least one enrolled student to avoid division by zero/null
    AND fr.K12Enroll > 0
),
with_mealrate_and_sat AS (
  SELECT
    school_name,
    grades_served,
    CASE WHEN charter_status = 'Y' THEN 'Yes'
         WHEN charter_status = 'N' THEN 'No'
         ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS is_charter,
    CAST(free_meal_count AS FLOAT) / enrollment AS free_meal_rate,
    grades_served AS grades_it_serves,
    -- Calculate SAT score and categorize performance
    CASE
      WHEN sat_read IS NULL AND sat_math IS NULL AND sat_writing IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN (IFNULL(sat_read, 0) + IFNULL(sat_math, 0) + IFNULL(sat_writing, 0)) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
          WHEN (IFNULL(sat_read, 0) + IFNULL(sat_math, 0) + IFNULL(sat_writing, 0)) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
          WHEN (IFNULL(sat_read, 0) + IFNULL(sat_math, 0) + IFNULL(sat_writing, 0)) > 1500 THEN 'Above Average'
        END
    END AS sat_performance_level
  FROM eligible_schools
),
with_max_rate AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    MAX(free_meal_rate) OVER () AS max_free_meal_rate
  FROM with_mealrate_and_sat
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  printf('%.4f', free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
  is_charter,
  grades_it_serves AS grades_served,
  sat_performance_level
FROM with_max_rate
WHERE free_meal_rate = max_free_meal_rate
ORDER BY school_name;

WITH school_profile AS (
  SELECT
    s."CDSCode" AS cds_code,
    s."School" AS name,
    s."Phone" AS phone_number,
    s."WebSite" AS website,
    sc."NumTstTkr" AS num_sat_test_takers,
    sc."AvgScrRead" AS avg_sat_reading,
    sc."AvgScrMath" AS avg_sat_math,
    sc."AvgScrWrite" AS avg_sat_writing,
    CASE WHEN s."Charter" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_charter_school,
    s."K12Enroll14_15" AS k12_enrollment_2014_2015,
    ROUND(CAST(s."FreeRedMeal14_15" AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(s."K12Enroll14_15", 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_free_reduced_meals_1415
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores sc ON s."CDSCode" = sc."CDSCode"
  WHERE s."CDSCode" = '7618040113118'
),
max_sat_math AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(sc."AvgScrMath") AS max_avg_sat_math
  FROM satscores sc
  JOIN schools s ON s."CDSCode" = sc."CDSCode"
  WHERE sc."NumTstTkr" >= 10
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    sp.*,
    ms.max_avg_sat_math,
    CASE
      WHEN sp.avg_sat_math IS NOT NULL AND ms.max_avg_sat_math IS NOT NULL
      THEN ROUND(CAST(ms.max_avg_sat_math AS FLOAT) - CAST(sp.avg_sat_math AS FLOAT), 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS math_deficit_vs_max
  FROM school_profile sp
  CROSS JOIN max_sat_math ms
)
SELECT
  cds_code,
  name,
  phone_number,
  website,
  avg_sat_reading,
  avg_sat_math,
  avg_sat_writing,
  is_charter_school,
  k12_enrollment_2014_2015,
  pct_free_reduced_meals_1415,
  max_avg_sat_math,
  math_deficit_vs_max
FROM final;

WITH exclusively_virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.county,
    s.name AS school_name,
    sa.reading_avg
  FROM schools s

  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'

  FROM abyssal_sets
  WHERE released_at = (SELECT MIN(released_at) FROM abyssal_sets)
  ORDER BY code
  LIMIT 1

latest_release AS (
  SELECT MIN(code) as code, name, released_at
  FROM sets
  WHERE released_at = (SELECT MAX(released_at) FROM sets)
  GROUP BY name, released_at
  ORDER BY code
  LIMIT 1

  GROUP BY s.name

guild_counts AS (

promotional_multiface_cards AS (

WITH target_expansion_type AS (

),
fts AS (

no_foreign_name AS (

WITH mindcensor_printings AS (

max_frame AS (

newest_frame_printings AS (

latest_release AS (

translation_counts AS (

WITH boros_jp_printings AS (

distinct_cards AS (

rulings_agg AS (

SELECT

WITH translated_sets AS (

flavor_text_translations AS (

min_count AS (

WITH commander_sets_2020 AS (
  SELECT s.id,
         s.name,
         s.released_at
  FROM sets s
  WHERE s.set_type = 'commander'
    AND s.released_at BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
),
cards_per_set AS (
  -- Count normal & promo cards but exclude Alchemy modifications
  SELECT c.set_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total_card_count
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.set_id IN (SELECT id FROM commander_sets_2020)
    AND (c.is_promo = 1 OR c.is_promo = 0 OR c.is_promo IS NULL)
    AND (c.is_online_only IS NULL OR c.is_online_only = 0) -- exclude online-only (Alchemy) modifications
  GROUP BY c.set_id
),
languages_per_set AS (
  SELECT st.set_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) as num_languages
  FROM set_translations st
  WHERE st.set_id IN (SELECT id FROM commander_sets_2020)
  GROUP BY st.set_id
),
joined AS (
  SELECT cs2020.id,
         cs2020.name,
         coalesce(cps.total_card_count,0) AS total_card_count,
         coalesce(lps.num_languages, 0) AS num_languages
  FROM commander_sets_2020 cs2020
  LEFT JOIN cards_per_set cps ON cs2020.id = cps.set_id
  LEFT JOIN languages_per_set lps ON cs2020.id = lps.set_id
)
SELECT id, name, num_languages
FROM joined
WHERE total_card_count = (SELECT MAX(total_card_count) FROM joined)
ORDER BY id ASC;

cards_with_foreign_flavor AS (

users_2010 AS (

germany_lastedit AS (

nongermany_lastedit AS (

germany_editors AS (

;

SELECT SUM(u.reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT postid
    FROM posttags
    JOIN tags t ON posttags.tagid = t.id

WHERE DATE(p.lastactivitydate) = '2014-08-27'

WITH r_tagged_questions AS (

),
linked_questions AS (

WITH german_users AS (

badge_counts AS (

),
max_badge_total AS (

),
second_max_badge_total AS (

SELECT bc.displayName, bc.badge_total

ORDER BY bc.displayName;

SELECT

),
related_counts AS (

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT

WITH active_contributors AS (
    SELECT
        p.owneruserid AS user_id
    FROM
        posts p
    WHERE
        strftime('%Y', p.creationdate) = '2012'
        AND p.owneruserid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        p.owneruserid
    HAVING
        COUNT(*) > 10
),
user_upvotes AS (
    SELECT
        v.userid AS user_id,
        COUNT(*) AS upvote_count
    FROM
        votes v
    WHERE
        v.votetypeid = 2 -- Up-vote
        AND v.userid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        v.userid
),
user_ages AS (
    SELECT
        u.id AS user_id,
        u.age
    FROM
        users u
    WHERE
        u.age IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(uu.upvote_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_upvotes_cast,
    ROUND(AVG(ua.age), 2) AS avg_age

    active_contributors ac

    LEFT JOIN user_ages ua ON ac.user_id = ua.user_id;

WITH posts_with_few_answers AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS post_id
  FROM
    posts p
  LEFT JOIN posts a
    ON a.parentId = p.id
    AND a.postTypeId = 2
  WHERE
    p.postTypeId = 1
  GROUP BY
    p.id
  HAVING
    COUNT(a.id) <= 2
),
linked_posts_by_month AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', pl.creationDate) AS month,
    pl.postId
  FROM
    postLinks pl
    INNER JOIN posts_with_few_answers pf ON pl.postId = pf.post_id
  WHERE
    strftime('%Y', pl.creationDate) = '2010'
),
counts_per_month AS (
  SELECT
    printf('%04d-%02d', 2010, m.month) AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lpbm.postId) AS num_posts

    (SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
     UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8
     UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12) m
    LEFT JOIN linked_posts_by_month lpbm
      ON strftime('%m', lpbm.month) = printf('%02d', m.month)
      AND strftime('%Y', lpbm.month) = '2010'
  GROUP BY
    m.month

avg_cnt AS (

WITH posts_2010 AS (

edit_comments AS (

    -- unpivot all home/away lineup slots into one list
    JOIN (

    WHERE p.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.season, p.player_api_id
),

    )

  , 2) AS percentage_higher_than_average
;

WITH running_debt_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE l.status = 'D'
),
district_unemp AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.district_name, d.year, d.unemploymant_rate_95, d.unemploymant_rate_96
  FROM district d
  WHERE d.year IN (1995, 1996)
)
SELECT 
  d.district_name,
  ROUND(
    ((d.unemploymant_rate_96 - d.unemploymant_rate_95) / d.unemploymant_rate_95) * 100.0,
    2
  ) AS percent_change_unemploy_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    du1.district_id,
    du1.district_name,
    du1.unemploymant_rate_95,
    du2.unemploymant_rate_96
  FROM
    (SELECT district_id, district_name, unemploymant_rate_95 FROM district WHERE year=1995) du1
    JOIN (SELECT district_id, unemploymant_rate_96 FROM district WHERE year=1996) du2
      ON du1.district_id = du2.district_id
) d
JOIN running_debt_accounts rda ON d.district_id = rda.district_id
WHERE d.unemploymant_rate_95 IS NOT NULL AND d.unemploymant_rate_96 IS NOT NULL

WITH first_month AS (
  SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y-%m', date)) AS first_month
  FROM account
),
first_month_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN first_month f ON strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = f.first_month
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
district_pop AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A3 AS population
  FROM district d
  JOIN first_month_accounts fma ON d.district_id = fma.district_id
),
max_pop AS (
  SELECT MAX(population) AS max_population
  FROM district_pop
)
SELECT dp.district_name, dp.population
FROM district_pop dp
JOIN max_pop mp ON dp.population = mp.max_population;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_transactions_without_purpose
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(c.birth_number, 1, 2) IN ('74', '75', '76')
  AND (t.payment_purpose IS NULL OR TRIM(t.payment_purpose) = '')
;

WITH loans_on_date AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount,
    d.district_name AS region
  FROM loan l
  JOIN client c ON l.account_id = c.account_id
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE
    date(l.date) <= '1995-12-31'
    AND date(l.date, '+' || (l.duration-1) || ' months') >= '1995-12-31'
)
, region_totals AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total_approved
  FROM loans_on_date
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT region, total_approved
FROM region_totals
WHERE total_approved = (SELECT MAX(total_approved) FROM region_totals);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.district_name = 'North Bohemia'
  AND date(a.date) <= '1995-12-31'

;

WITH east_bohemia_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, a2.name AS district_name, a2.AVERAGE_SALARY
    FROM district a2
    WHERE a2.region = 'East Bohemia'
),
clients_born_80s AS (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.birth_number BETWEEN 800101 AND 891231
),
districts_with_80s_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id
    FROM east_bohemia_districts d
    JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN clients_born_80s c80 ON dp.client_id = c80.client_id
),
salaries AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.AVERAGE_SALARY
    FROM east_bohemia_districts d
    WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM districts_with_80s_clients)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(s.AVERAGE_SALARY), 2) AS avg_of_avg_salaries,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM salaries s;

WITH central_bohemia_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT A1.code AS district_code
    FROM district A1
    WHERE A1.name LIKE '%bohemia%'
      AND LOWER(A1.name) LIKE '%central%'
),
qualified_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.district_id IN (SELECT district_code FROM central_bohemia_districts)

          SELECT 1
          FROM card ca
          JOIN disp d2 ON ca.disp_id = d2.disp_id
          WHERE d2.account_id = d.account_id
      )
),
districts_of_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM qualified_clients c
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(district.Average_salary), 2) AS avg_district_average_salary
FROM district
WHERE district.code IN (SELECT district_id FROM districts_of_clients);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
    GROUP BY a.account_id
)
;

WITH male_customers_74_76 AS (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', c.birth_number, 'unixepoch') IN ('1974', '1975', '1976')
),
accounts_of_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM male_customers_74_76)
),
large_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.type, t.operation, t.purpose
    FROM trans t
    WHERE 
        t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_of_cohort)
        AND t.amount > 4000
        AND t.type = 'debit'
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.purpose = 'household payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS household_payment_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.purpose IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose <> 'household payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_purpose_count
FROM large_payments t
WHERE t.purpose IS NOT NULL
;

WITH prachatice_branch_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date_opened
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.name = 'Prachatice'
),
borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM prachatice_branch_accounts)
),
account_owner AS (
    SELECT
        d.account_id,
        c.client_id AS owner_id,
        c.district_id AS home_district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
home_district_info AS (
    SELECT
        acc.account_id,
        acc.date_opened,
        acc_owner.owner_id,
        acc_owner.home_district_id,
        hd.name as home_district_name,
        hd.a2 as home_district_region,
        hd.population AS home_district_population
    FROM prachatice_branch_accounts acc
    JOIN account_owner acc_owner ON acc.account_id = acc_owner.account_id
    JOIN district hd ON acc_owner.home_district_id = hd.district_id
    WHERE acc.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM borrowing_accounts)
),
total_borrowed AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM borrowing_accounts)
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
outside_bank_counterparties AS (
    -- We consider both incoming and outgoing transfers involving another bank.
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank_to || ':' || t.account_to) AS outside_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM borrowing_accounts)
      AND t.type = 'transfer'
      AND t.bank_to IS NOT NULL
      AND (t.bank_to != 'Bank') -- Assuming 'Bank' means our bank
    GROUP BY t.account_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank_from || ':' || t.account_from)
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM borrowing_accounts)
      AND t.type = 'transfer'
      AND t.bank_from IS NOT NULL
      AND (t.bank_from != 'Bank')
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
counterparty_agg AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(outside_counterparties) AS num_outside_counterparties
    FROM outside_bank_counterparties
    GROUP BY account_id
),
all_results AS (
    SELECT
        hdi.account_id,
        hdi.date_opened,
        IFNULL(tb.total_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_ever_borrowed,
        COALESCE(ca.num_outside_counterparties, 0) AS num_outside_bank_counterparties,
        hdi.home_district_name,
        hdi.home_district_population
    FROM home_district_info hdi
    LEFT JOIN total_borrowed tb ON hdi.account_id = tb.account_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparty_agg ca ON hdi.account_id = ca.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    date_opened,
    total_amount_ever_borrowed,
    num_outside_bank_counterparties,
    home_district_name,
    home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, account_id ASC
    ) AS home_district_population_rank
FROM all_results
ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, account_id ASC;

WITH gold_card_holders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        c.gender,
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp d ON cd.disp_id = d.disp_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
),
account_avg_bal AS (
    SELECT 
        t.account_id,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
target_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        gch.client_id,
        gch.gender,
        gch.account_id,
        gch.district_id
    FROM gold_card_holders gch
    JOIN account_avg_bal aab ON gch.account_id = aab.account_id
    WHERE aab.avg_balance > 1000
),
district_gold_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ta.gender,
        ta.district_id
    FROM target_accounts ta
),
eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        dgu.gender,
        dgu.district_id,
        d.inhabitants,
        d.avg_salary,
        d.urban_inhabitants_ratio
    FROM district_gold_users dgu
    JOIN district d ON dgu.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.inhabitants > 100000
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        gender,
        COUNT(*) AS district_count,
        MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants
    FROM eligible_districts
    GROUP BY gender
),
max_inhabitants_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        ed.gender, 
        ed.district_id, 
        ed.inhabitants
    FROM eligible_districts ed
    JOIN summary s ON ed.gender = s.gender AND ed.inhabitants = s.max_inhabitants
),
salary_urban AS (
    SELECT
        gender,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(urban_inhabitants_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_inhabitants_ratio
    FROM eligible_districts
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT
    s.gender,
    s.district_count,
    mid.district_id AS max_inhabitants_district_id,
    mid.inhabitants AS max_inhabitants_value,
    su.avg_salary,
    su.avg_urban_inhabitants_ratio
FROM summary s
JOIN max_inhabitants_districts mid ON s.gender = mid.gender
JOIN salary_urban su ON s.gender = su.gender
ORDER BY s.gender, mid.district_id;

WITH large_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 >= 250000
),
gold_card_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT disp.account_id
    FROM card
    JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
    WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
accounts_in_large_districts AS (
    SELECT account.account_id
    FROM account
    JOIN large_districts ON account.district_id = large_districts.district_id
),
target_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM gold_card_owners gco
    JOIN accounts_in_large_districts a ON gco.account_id = a.account_id
),
vydej_trans AS (
    SELECT t.*
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_accounts ta ON t.account_id = ta.account_id
    WHERE
        t.type = 'VYDAJ'
        AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
        AND t.date <= '1998-12-31'
        AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
        AND t.account2 IS NOT NULL
),
rec_sums AS (
    SELECT
        bank AS recipient_bank_code,
        account2 AS recipient_counter_account,
        COUNT(*) AS num_outgoing_payments,
        SUM(amount) AS total_paid
    FROM vydej_trans
    GROUP BY bank, account2
),
max_total AS (
    SELECT MAX(total_paid) AS max_paid
    FROM rec_sums
)
SELECT
    r.recipient_bank_code,
    r.recipient_counter_account,
    r.num_outgoing_payments,
    r.total_paid
FROM
    rec_sums r
    JOIN max_total m ON r.total_paid = m.max_paid
ORDER BY
    r.recipient_bank_code,
    r.recipient_counter_account;

WITH pisek_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.district_name = 'Pisek'
),
purposeful_outgoing AS (
  SELECT t.trans_id, t.amount, t.k_symbol
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)
    AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''
),
total_with_purpose AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM purposeful_outgoing
),
sipo_amount AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS sipo_total
  FROM purposeful_outgoing
  WHERE k_symbol = 'SIPO'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * (SELECT sipo_total FROM sipo_amount) / 
    (SELECT total_amount FROM total_with_purpose), 
    2
  ) AS sipo_percentage;

WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
owner_disps AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
female_owner_accounts AS (
    SELECT fc.client_id, fc.district_id, od.account_id
    FROM female_clients fc
    JOIN owner_disps od ON fc.client_id = od.client_id
),
cc_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.account_id
    FROM card ca
),
loan_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
),
target_clients AS (
    -- female, owner, has at least one credit card and at least one loan, tracked per account
    SELECT foa.client_id, foa.district_id, foa.account_id
    FROM female_owner_accounts foa
    JOIN cc_accounts cca ON foa.account_id = cca.account_id
    JOIN loan_accounts la ON foa.account_id = la.account_id
),
district_with_stats AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.district_name, d.region, d.unemployment_rate_1996, d.average_salary, d.no_inhabitants
    FROM district d
),
target_districts AS (
    -- Each district associated with a target client (multiple clients may map to same district)
    SELECT DISTINCT tws.region, tws.district_id, tws.district_name, tws.unemployment_rate_1996, tws.average_salary, tws.no_inhabitants
    FROM target_clients tc
    JOIN district_with_stats tws ON tc.district_id = tws.district_id
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT
        tds.region,
        ROUND(AVG(tds.average_salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
        ROUND(AVG(tds.unemployment_rate_1996), 2) AS avg_unemployment_rate_1996
    FROM target_districts tds
    GROUP BY tds.region
),
most_populous_districts AS (
    SELECT
        tds.region,
        tds.district_name,
        tds.no_inhabitants
    FROM (
        SELECT
            region,
            district_name,
            no_inhabitants,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY region
                ORDER BY no_inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC
            ) AS rn
        FROM target_districts
    ) sub
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    rs.region,
    rs.avg_district_salary,
    rs.avg_unemployment_rate_1996,
    mpd.district_name AS most_populous_district
FROM region_stats rs
JOIN most_populous_districts mpd ON rs.region = mpd.region
ORDER BY rs.region;

WITH central_bohemia_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        district.district_id,
        district.name AS district_name,
        district.inhabitants
    FROM district
    WHERE district.region = 'Central Bohemia'
),
top3_cb_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        district_id,
        district_name,
        inhabitants
    FROM central_bohemia_districts
    ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, REPLACE(LOWER(district_name), 'á', 'a') ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
crime_1996_by_district AS (
    SELECT 
        d.district_id,
        SUM(acc.crimes) AS crimes_1996
    FROM district d
    LEFT JOIN account acc ON acc.district_id = d.district_id AND strftime('%Y', acc.date) = '1996'
    GROUP BY d.district_id
),
top3_cb_districts_with_crime AS (
    SELECT 
        t3.district_name,
        t3.inhabitants,
        COALESCE(c.crimes_1996, 0) AS crimes_1996
    FROM top3_cb_districts t3
    LEFT JOIN crime_1996_by_district c ON t3.district_id = c.district_id
),
all_district_crime_1996 AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(acc.crimes), 0) AS crimes_1996
    FROM district d
    LEFT JOIN account acc ON acc.district_id = d.district_id AND strftime('%Y', acc.date) = '1996'
    GROUP BY d.district_id
),
three_district_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(crimes_1996 * 1.0), 2) AS avg_crimes_1996
    FROM top3_cb_districts_with_crime
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(crimes_1996 * 1.0), 2) AS country_avg_crimes_1996
    FROM all_district_crime_1996
)
SELECT 
    t3.district_name,
    t3.inhabitants,
    t3.crimes_1996,
    tdavg.avg_crimes_1996 AS avg_crimes_1996_top3,
    oavg.country_avg_crimes_1996 AS avg_crimes_1996_country,
    ROUND(tdavg.avg_crimes_1996 - oavg.country_avg_crimes_1996, 2) AS avg_difference
FROM top3_cb_districts_with_crime t3
CROSS JOIN three_district_avg tdavg
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oavg
ORDER BY t3.inhabitants DESC, REPLACE(LOWER(t3.district_name), 'á', 'a') ASC
;

WITH card_types AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT type FROM card WHERE type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
card_holder_districts AS (
    SELECT
        c.type AS card_type,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS inhabitants
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dp ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
min_inhabitants_per_type AS (
    SELECT
        card_type,
        MIN(inhabitants) AS min_inhabitants
    FROM card_holder_districts
    GROUP BY card_type
)
SELECT
    c.card_type,
    c.district_name,
    c.inhabitants AS district_inhabitants
FROM card_holder_districts c
JOIN min_inhabitants_per_type m
    ON c.card_type = m.card_type AND c.inhabitants = m.min_inhabitants
ORDER BY c.card_type, c.district_name

WITH litomerice_region AS (
    SELECT region
    FROM district
    WHERE name = 'Litomerice'
    LIMIT 1
),
districts_in_region AS (
    SELECT code, name
    FROM district
    WHERE region = (SELECT region FROM litomerice_region)
),
accounts_1996 AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.district_id IN (SELECT code FROM districts_in_region)
      AND DATE(a.date) BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
),
last_trans_1996 AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        MAX(t.date) AS last_date_1996
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_1996)
      AND DATE(t.date) <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
latest_trans_per_account AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        t.balance,
        t.trans_id
    FROM trans t
    INNER JOIN last_trans_1996 l
        ON t.account_id = l.account_id
        AND t.date = l.last_date_1996
),
end_of_year_balance AS (
    -- For accounts with multiple transactions on the last date, pick one with max trans_id
    SELECT
        lt.account_id,
        lt.balance
    FROM (
        SELECT
            l.account_id,
            MAX(l.trans_id) AS max_trans_id
        FROM latest_trans_per_account l
        GROUP BY l.account_id
    ) mx
    INNER JOIN latest_trans_per_account lt
        ON lt.account_id = mx.account_id AND lt.trans_id = mx.max_trans_id
),
district_summary AS (
    SELECT
        d.name AS district_name,
        d.code AS district_code,
        COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts,
        ROUND(AVG(e.balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM districts_in_region d
    JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.code
    JOIN accounts_1996 ac ON ac.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN end_of_year_balance e ON e.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY d.name, d.code
    HAVING COUNT(a.account_id) > 0
),
region_wide_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(e.balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM accounts_1996 ac
    JOIN end_of_year_balance e ON ac.account_id = e.account_id
),
max_avg_district AS (
    SELECT
        district_name,
        avg_balance
    FROM district_summary
    WHERE avg_balance = (SELECT MAX(avg_balance) FROM district_summary)
    ORDER BY district_name ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ds.district_name,
    ds.num_accounts,
    ds.avg_balance,
    rwa.avg_balance AS region_wide_avg_balance,
    mad.district_name AS max_avg_balance_district
FROM district_summary ds
CROSS JOIN region_wide_avg rwa
CROSS JOIN max_avg_district mad
ORDER BY ds.district_name
;

WITH loans_cte AS (
    SELECT
        loan.loan_id,
        loan.account_id,
        loan.amount,
        account.district_id
    FROM loan
    JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
    JOIN order AS o ON o.account_id = account.account_id
    WHERE loan.duration = 24
      AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
      AND o.k_symbol = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
    GROUP BY loan.loan_id
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        account_id,
        amount,
        district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY amount DESC, loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loans_cte
),
top10_loans AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM ranked_loans
    WHERE rn <= 10
),
districts_of_top10 AS (

),
most_populous AS (

),
salary_stats AS (

)
SELECT

WITH
districts_with_100k AS (

),
accounts_per_district AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        a.account_id
    FROM districts_with_100k d
    JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
),
withdrawals AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 1 END) AS withdrawal_cnt
    FROM accounts_per_district a
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
    HAVING withdrawal_cnt > 0
),
withdrawal_per_inhabitant AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.district_name,
        d.region,
        d.population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        ROUND(CAST(w.total_withdrawn AS REAL) / d.population, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant
    FROM districts_with_100k d
    JOIN withdrawals w ON d.district_id = w.district_id
),
so_per_account AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0.0) /
            CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS REAL), 2
        ) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM districts_with_100k d
    JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id AND o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
    GROUP BY d.district_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        wpi.*,
        sop.avg_standing_order_debit_per_account,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC
        ) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank
    FROM withdrawal_per_inhabitant wpi
    JOIN so_per_account sop ON wpi.district_id = sop.district_id
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank,

FROM ranked
ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant_rank, district_name;

WITH client_home AS (
  SELECT client_id, district_id as home_district_id
  FROM client
  WHERE client_id = 3541
),
account_access AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.frequency, a.date,
         ch.home_district_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN client_home ch ON d.client_id = ch.client_id
  WHERE d.client_id = 3541
),
account_district AS (
  SELECT ad.*, d.name as district_name, d.region, d.A3 as avg_salary, d.A1 as num_inhabitants
  FROM account_access ad
  JOIN district d ON ad.district_id = d.district_id
),
loan_info AS (
  SELECT account_id, 'Running' AS loan_status, amount, payments
  FROM loan
  WHERE status = 'A'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT account_id, 'Finished', amount, payments FROM loan WHERE status = 'C'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT account_id, 'Default', amount, payments FROM loan WHERE status = 'B'
),
transaction_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
region_client_count AS (
  SELECT d.region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.region
),
region_populace AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    name as district_name,
    A1 as num_inhabitants
  FROM district
),
region_pop_rank AS (
  SELECT 
    region, 
    district_id,
    num_inhabitants,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY num_inhabitants DESC) AS pop_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT region, district_id, A1 as num_inhabitants
    FROM district
  )
),
region_most_populous AS (
  SELECT region, district_id, name as district_name, A1 as num_inhabitants
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      region, 
      district_id, 
      name, 
      A1, 
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY A1 DESC) AS rnk
    FROM district
  )
  WHERE rnk = 1
)
SELECT 
  ad.account_id,
  ad.date AS account_opened_date,
  ad.frequency,
  ad.district_name AS account_district_name,
  ad.region AS region,
  CASE WHEN ad.district_id = ad.home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
  ad.avg_salary,
  COALESCE(l.loan_status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
  COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
  COALESCE(ts.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions,
  COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  COALESCE(ts.net_balance, 0) AS net_balance,
  rcc.client_count AS region_client_count,
  rmp.district_name AS most_populous_district_name,
  rmp.num_inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
  rpr.pop_rank AS account_district_population_rank_in_region
FROM account_district ad
LEFT JOIN loan_info l ON ad.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_stats ts ON ad.account_id = ts.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_client_count rcc ON ad.region = rcc.region
LEFT JOIN region_most_populous rmp ON ad.region = rmp.region
LEFT JOIN region_pop_rank rpr ON ad.region = rpr.region AND ad.district_id = rpr.district_id
ORDER BY num_transactions DESC, ad.account_id ASC
;

WITH central_bohemia_districts AS (

loans_by_account AS (

district_yearly_stats AS (

),
avg_lent_per_account_by_district_year AS (

year_summary AS (

WITH poplatek_accounts AS (

loans_24m AS (

),
target_loans AS (

),
loan_balances AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.trans_id, t.balance

),
ranked_transactions AS (

        tl.loan_id,
        tl.account_id,
        tl.amount,
        tl.approval_date,
        tl.district_id,
        tb.balance,
        tb.trans_id,

select_largest AS (

WITH female_clients AS (
  SELECT client_id, birth_number
  FROM client
  WHERE gender = 'F'
),
approved_loans AS (
  SELECT
    loan_id,
    account_id,
    amount,
    duration,
    payments,
    status,
    client_id
  FROM loan

    AND status = 'A'
),
largest_loan_amounts AS (
  SELECT amount
  FROM approved_loans
  JOIN female_clients ON approved_loans.client_id = female_clients.client_id
  GROUP BY amount
  ORDER BY amount DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
top_loans AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.account_id,
    l.amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments,
    l.status,
    l.client_id
  FROM approved_loans l
  JOIN female_clients f ON l.client_id = f.client_id
  WHERE l.amount IN (SELECT amount FROM largest_loan_amounts)
),
account_branch AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id,
    d.district_name,
    d.region,
    d.AverageSalary
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
region_salary AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    ROUND(AVG(AverageSalary), 2) AS region_avg_salary
  FROM district
  GROUP BY region
),
loan_region_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.region,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loans_in_region
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.region
),
account_transactions AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_deposits
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
client_birthday AS (
  -- birth_number: YYMMDDnnnc / If month > 50, subtract 50 for birth month for females
  SELECT
    client_id,
    CAST('19' || SUBSTR(birth_number, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number,3,2) AS INTEGER) > 50
        THEN CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number,3,2) AS INTEGER) - 50
      ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number,3,2) AS INTEGER)
    END AS birth_month,
    CAST(SUBSTR(birth_number, 5, 2) AS INTEGER) AS birth_day
  FROM female_clients
),
client_age AS (
  SELECT
    client_id,
    (CASE
      WHEN birth_month < 10 THEN
        CAST(birth_year || '-0' || birth_month || '-' || 
        (CASE WHEN birth_day<10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END) || birth_day AS DATE)
      ELSE
        CAST(birth_year || '-' || birth_month || '-' || 
        (CASE WHEN birth_day<10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END) || birth_day AS DATE)
    END) AS birthdate,
    birth_year,
    birth_month,
    birth_day,
    -- Calculate completed age by 2026-10-09
    (2026 - birth_year) - (CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_age
  FROM client_birthday
)
SELECT
  tl.client_id,
  tl.amount AS loan_amount,
  tl.duration AS loan_duration_months,
  ROUND(tl.payments * tl.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND((tl.payments * tl.duration) - tl.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
  tl.status AS loan_status,
  ab.district_name,
  ab.region,
  at.trans_count AS account_transaction_count,
  IFNULL(at.total_deposits, 0) AS account_total_deposits,
  CASE
    WHEN IFNULL(at.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * tl.amount THEN 'High Income'
    WHEN IFNULL(at.total_deposits, 0) > tl.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
    ELSE 'Low Income'
  END AS income_category,
  lrc.loans_in_region,
  rs.region_avg_salary,
  ca.completed_age AS client_completed_age_on_2026_10_09
FROM top_loans tl
JOIN account_branch ab ON tl.account_id = ab.account_id
JOIN region_salary rs ON ab.region = rs.region
JOIN loan_region_counts lrc ON ab.region = lrc.region
LEFT JOIN account_transactions at ON tl.account_id = at.account_id
JOIN client_age ca ON tl.client_id = ca.client_id
ORDER BY loan_amount DESC
;

),
qualified_districts AS (

SELECT

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN card c ON a.account_id = c.account_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND c.card_type = 'credit'
),
district_info AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.name AS district_name,
        d.region
    FROM district d
),
external_trans AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        t.trans_type,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.trans_type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.trans_type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        -- To count unique external counterparties, use bank_to and bank_k_symbol not null & not own bank
        COUNT(DISTINCT
            CASE
                WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> '' THEN t.bank || '-' || IFNULL(t.account_to,'') -- positive identifier for external
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS ext_counterparty_count
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS num_loans
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        g.account_id,
        d.district_name,
        d.region,
        COALESCE(e.total_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
        COALESCE(e.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(lc.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans,
        COALESCE(e.ext_counterparty_count, 0) AS num_external_counterparties
    FROM gold_accounts g
    LEFT JOIN district_info d ON g.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN external_trans e ON g.account_id = e.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc ON g.account_id = lc.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_amount_received,
    total_amount_withdrawn,
    num_loans,
    num_external_counterparties,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY num_external_counterparties DESC) AS ext_counterparty_rank
FROM final
ORDER BY ext_counterparty_rank, account_id
;

WITH tabor_branch AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date AS account_open_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
),
owner_info AS (
    SELECT disp.account_id, c.gender,
        CAST((julianday('1996-12-31') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_on_1996_12_31
    FROM disp
    JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards_issued AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS num_cards
    FROM card
    WHERE issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loans_approved AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_loans,
           MAX(status) AS max_status_B,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status IN ('C','D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_status_CD,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_status_A
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
loan_status_label AS (
    SELECT tabor_branch.account_id,
        CASE
            WHEN la.num_loans IS NULL OR la.num_loans = 0 THEN 'no loan'
            WHEN la.max_status_B = 'B' THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN la.any_status_CD = 1 THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing
    FROM tabor_branch
    LEFT JOIN loans_approved la ON tabor_branch.account_id = la.account_id
),
trans_97 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_transactions,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01' AND date <= '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
balance_points AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.date,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount
            WHEN t.type IN ('debit','withdrawal') THEN -t.amount
            ELSE 0 END
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id ORDER BY t.date, t.trans_id
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date >= '1997-01-01' AND t.date <= '1997-12-31'
),
peak_balance_97 AS (
    SELECT account_id, 
           COALESCE(MAX(running_balance), 0) AS peak_balance_97
    FROM balance_points
    GROUP BY account_id
),
final AS (
    SELECT tb.account_id,
           tb.account_open_date,
           oi.gender,
           oi.age_on_1996_12_31,
           COALESCE(ci.num_cards, 0) AS num_cards_issued,
           COALESCE(la.num_loans, 0) AS num_loans_approved,
           lsl.loan_standing,
           COALESCE(t97.num_transactions, 0) AS num_transactions_1997,
           COALESCE(t97.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
           COALESCE(t97.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
           COALESCE(pb.peak_balance_97, 0) AS peak_balance_1997
    FROM tabor_branch tb
    LEFT JOIN owner_info oi ON tb.account_id = oi.account_id
    LEFT JOIN cards_issued ci ON tb.account_id = ci.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loans_approved la ON tb.account_id = la.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_status_label lsl ON tb.account_id = lsl.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_97 t97 ON tb.account_id = t97.account_id
    LEFT JOIN peak_balance_97 pb ON tb.account_id = pb.account_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,

        AND (
            CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1,1,2) AS INTEGER) < 2 -- under 2 minutes: 0 or 1 as leading digits

            (CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1,1,2) AS INTEGER) = 2 AND CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1,4,2) AS INTEGER) = 0 AND CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1,7) AS INTEGER) = 0)

WITH race_start_times AS (

  FROM races
  JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
  WHERE races.time IS NOT NULL AND length(races.time) >= 8
)
, min_max_times AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_start,
    MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_start
  FROM race_start_times
)

  'earliest' AS type,
  circuitRef,
  start_seconds AS start_time_seconds,
  0 AS gap_seconds
FROM race_start_times r
JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_seconds = m.earliest_start

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'latest' AS type,
  circuitRef,
  start_seconds AS start_time_seconds,
  latest_start - earliest_start AS gap_seconds
FROM race_start_times r
JOIN min_max_times m ON r.start_seconds = m.latest_start;

WITH over_budget_event_ids AS (

  HAVING SUM(e.amount) > SUM(b.amount)
),
kinds AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(value) AS kind
  FROM expense
  JOIN over_budget_event_ids ON expense.event_id = over_budget_event_ids.event_id
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
      expense_id,
      value
    FROM (
      SELECT
        expense_id,
        REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(description, ';', ','), '/', ','), '|', ',') AS cleaned_desc
      FROM expense
    ) AS cleaned
    JOIN (
      SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
      UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
    ) numbers
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(cleaned_desc,
        instr(cleaned_desc||',', ',', numbers.n)+1,
        instr(SUBSTR(cleaned_desc||',', instr(cleaned_desc||',', ',', numbers.n)+1), ',')-1
      ) AS value,
      expense_id
      FROM (
        SELECT
          expense_id,
          REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(description, ';', ','), '/', ','), '|', ',') AS cleaned_desc
        FROM expense
      ) cleaned
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
        UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
      ) numbers
    ) split ON split.expense_id = cleaned.expense_id
    WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(value) <> ''
  )
)

FROM kinds

WITH relevant_patients AS (
  -- Find patients diagnosed with exactly RA and SJS, and nothing else (except 'suspected' only records).
  SELECT p.patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.patient_id = e.patient_id
  WHERE e.status = 'diagnosed'
    AND e.code IN ('RA', 'SJS')
  GROUP BY p.patient_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.code IN ('RA', 'SJS') THEN e.code END) = 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.code NOT IN ('RA', 'SJS') AND e.status = 'diagnosed' THEN e.code END) = 0
),
lab_platelet AS (
  -- For each relevant patient, find if they have a normal platelet result
  SELECT rp.patient_id,
         MAX(
           CASE
             WHEN l.platelet > 100 AND l.platelet < 400 THEN 1
             ELSE 0
           END
         ) AS has_normal_platelet
  FROM relevant_patients rp
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON rp.patient_id = l.patient_id
  GROUP BY rp.patient_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_without_normal_platelet
FROM lab_platelet;

WITH thrombosis_women AS (

  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.Gender = 'Female'
    AND p.Cohort = 'Thrombosis'
),
anr_results AS (
  SELECT
    e.PatientID,
    e.Result
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.TestName = 'Anti-ribonuclear protein'
),
filtered_patients AS (
  SELECT tw.PatientID, ar.Result
  FROM thrombosis_women tw
  JOIN anr_results ar ON tw.PatientID = ar.PatientID
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN
      -- Exclude "Negative" (which is never elevated)
      -- Assume titer result strings like "1:128" and elevated means strictly > 1:64
      -- Also, handle lowercase/uppercase and spacing in titer results
      (ar_titer > 64)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2
  ) AS percent_with_elevated_result
FROM (
  SELECT
    fp.PatientID,
    fp.Result,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(fp.Result) = 'negative' THEN 0
      WHEN fp.Result LIKE '1:%'
        AND
        CAST(SUBSTR(fp.Result, INSTR(fp.Result, ':')+1) AS INTEGER) > 0
      THEN CAST(SUBSTR(fp.Result, INSTR(fp.Result, ':')+1) AS INTEGER)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS ar_titer
  FROM filtered_patients fp
  -- Exclude clearly invalid, null, or unparseable/missing results
  WHERE fp.Result IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE ar_titer IS NOT NULL

WITH LDH_qualifying_visits AS (

Protein_qualifying_visits AS (

Single_qualifying_visit_patients AS (

sex_counts AS (

anti_rnp_results AS (

joined AS (

WITH sle_patients AS (

anti_dna_results AS (

max_anti_dna AS (

WITH latest_IgG AS (
  SELECT

    l.care_setting,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.patient_id, l.care_setting ORDER BY l.measurement_time DESC) AS rn

cohort AS (

    p.patient_id,
    s.care_setting
  FROM

    JOIN (

    AND CAST(Lab_LDH.Result AS FLOAT) >= 500
JOIN Laboratory AS Lab_Prot
    ON Patient.PatientID = Lab_Prot.PatientID
    AND Lab_Prot.LabTestName = 'Urinary protein'
    -- Handle formats: direct numeric, '>=value', '+2(value)', etc.
    AND (
        -- Direct numeric (e.g., '100')
        (Lab_Prot.Result GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(Lab_Prot.Result AS FLOAT) >= 100)
        OR
        -- '>=value' format
        (Lab_Prot.Result LIKE '>=%' AND CAST(SUBSTR(Lab_Prot.Result,3) AS FLOAT) >= 100)
        OR
        -- dipstick with mg/dL value in parentheses (e.g., '+2(100)')
        (Lab_Prot.Result LIKE '%(%)'
            AND CAST(
                SUBSTR(
                    Lab_Prot.Result,
                    INSTR(Lab_Prot.Result, '(')+1,
                    INSTR(Lab_Prot.Result, ')') - INSTR(Lab_Prot.Result, '(') - 1
                ) AS FLOAT
            ) >= 100
        )
    )
ORDER BY
    Patient.PatientID;

counts AS (

unique_element_molecules AS (

candidate_molecules AS (

bonds_of_interest AS (

SELECT bond_id, molecule_id

WITH molecules_with_nitrogen AS (

),
molecules_with_n_nondoubletriple AS (

labeled_molecules AS (

WITH rare_elements AS (

    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) = 1
),
carcinogenic_mols AS (

),
mols_with_rare_elem AS (

    JOIN carcinogenic_mols cm ON a.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id

bond_counts AS (

    JOIN atom a ON mre.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND mre.element = a.element
    JOIN bond b ON (a.atom_id = b.atom1_id OR a.atom_id = b.atom2_id)
    GROUP BY mre.molecule_id

SELECT
    molecule_id,
    rare_element_bond_count
FROM bond_counts
ORDER BY molecule_id;

WITH
molecule_basic AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS molecule_id,
    m.carcinogenicity
  FROM molecule m
),
atom_counts AS (
  SELECT
    a.molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_chlorines
  FROM atom a
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C'
        THEN
          CASE
            -- If both ends are C, only count once per bond
            WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 1
            ELSE 1
          END
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('DOUBLE', 'TRIPLE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_multiple_bonds
  FROM bond b
    JOIN atom a1 ON b.atom1_id = a1.id
    JOIN atom a2 ON b.atom2_id = a2.id
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY
      COALESCE(bond_counts.num_carbon_touching_bonds,0) DESC,
      COALESCE(atom_counts.num_atoms,0) DESC,
      molecule_basic.molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  molecule_basic.molecule_id,
  molecule_basic.carcinogenicity,
  COALESCE(atom_counts.num_atoms,0) AS num_atoms,
  COALESCE(bond_counts.num_bonds,0) AS num_bonds,
  COALESCE(atom_counts.num_carbons,0) AS num_carbons,
  COALESCE(atom_counts.num_chlorines,0) AS num_chlorines,
  COALESCE(bond_counts.num_carbon_touching_bonds,0) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
  COALESCE(bond_counts.num_multiple_bonds,0) AS num_multiple_bonds
FROM molecule_basic
LEFT JOIN atom_counts ON molecule_basic.molecule_id = atom_counts.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond_counts ON molecule_basic.molecule_id = bond_counts.molecule_id
WHERE COALESCE(atom_counts.num_carbons,0) >= 1
ORDER BY
  num_carbon_touching_bonds DESC,
  num_atoms DESC,
  molecule_basic.molecule_id ASC
;

SELECT 
  a2.element AS element,
  COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM 
  molecule m
JOIN 
  bond b ON m.id = b.molecule_id
JOIN 
  atom a1 ON b.atom1_id = a1.id
JOIN 
  atom a2 ON b.atom2_id = a2.id
WHERE 
  m.label = '-' -- Non-carcinogenic molecules
  AND (
    (a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element != 'C')
    OR
    (a2.element = 'C' AND a1.element != 'C')
  )
  AND b.bond_type IN ('DOUBLE', 'TRIPLE')
GROUP BY 
  element
ORDER BY 
  bond_count DESC;

WITH mol AS (
  SELECT m.id, m.label
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE m.name = 'TR377'
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.kind AS bond_kind,
    COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
      CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element
           THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element
           ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element END
    ) AS num_element_pairs
  FROM bond b
  JOIN mol ON b.molecule_id = mol.id
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.atom1_id = a1.id
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.atom2_id = a2.id
  WHERE b.kind IN ('-', '=')
    AND b.molecule_id = mol.id
  GROUP BY b.kind
)
SELECT
  bond_counts.bond_kind AS bond_kind_symbol,
  bond_counts.num_bonds,
  bond_counts.num_element_pairs,
  mol.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_counts
CROSS JOIN mol
ORDER BY bond_counts.num_bonds DESC, bond_counts.bond_kind ASC

WITH metal_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE lower(atom_name) IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
),
single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY molecule_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond b2 WHERE b2.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id)
),
non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '-'
)
SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN metal_atoms ma ON m.molecule_id = ma.molecule_id
JOIN single_bond_molecules sb ON m.molecule_id = sb.molecule_id
JOIN non_carcinogenic_molecules nc ON m.molecule_id = nc.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH atom_bond_types AS (
  SELECT
    a.id AS atom_id,
    a.symbol,
    COUNT(b.id) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_bond_count
  FROM atom a
  JOIN bond b
    ON a.id = b.atom1_id OR a.id = b.atom2_id
  GROUP BY a.id, a.symbol
)
SELECT
  symbol,
  COUNT(*) AS saturated_atom_count
FROM atom_bond_types
WHERE
  bond_count > 0
  AND bond_count = single_bond_count
  AND multi_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY symbol
ORDER BY symbol;

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
elements_in_triple_bond AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id, a.element
    FROM bond b
    JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND (b.atom1_id = a.atom_id OR b.atom2_id = a.atom_id)
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
),
element_molecule_count AS (
    SELECT e.element, COUNT(DISTINCT e.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
    FROM elements_in_triple_bond e
    GROUP BY e.element
)
SELECT emc.element, emc.molecule_count
FROM element_molecule_count emc
ORDER BY emc.molecule_count DESC, emc.element ASC;

SELECT
  a.element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM
  atom a
JOIN
  bond b
    ON a.id = b.atom1 OR a.id = b.atom2
WHERE
  a.molecule = 'TR397'
GROUP BY
  a.element
ORDER BY
  a.element ASC;
